# pulse_user (Data Source)

Looks up a dashboard user by ID or email, for example to link an SSO identity to a user that was created on the dashboard or by just-in-time provisioning. Set exactly one of `id` and `email`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A user created on the dashboard or by just-in-time provisioning.
data "pulse_user" "bob" {
  email = "bob@example.com"
}

output "bob_roles" {
  value = data.pulse_user.bob.all_roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address (case-insensitive). Set this or `id`.
- `id` (String) User ID. Set this or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `all_roles` (Set of String) Every role the user holds.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the dashboard.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user can sign in.
- `has_password` (Boolean) Whether the user has set a password.
- `mfa_enrolled` (Boolean) Whether the user has enrolled an authenticator app.
- `mfa_required` (Boolean) Whether the user must use an authenticator app for password sign-in.
- `provisioned_via` (String) How the user was created (`admin`, `jit`, …).
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles assigned to the user directly.
- `sso_roles` (Set of String) Roles the user holds through SSO group mappings.
